summary: Receives MoSys camera-tracking packets over UDP or multicast UDP for virtual camera control and lens-distortion workflows.

key_params.name: protocol
key_params.note: Messaging UDP or multicast messaging UDP

key_params.name: port
key_params.note: Network port for incoming MoSys packets

key_params.name: localaddress
key_params.note: Local NIC/IP address to receive on

key_params.name: cameraid
key_params.note: Filter packets by camera ID; blank accepts the latest packet per frame

key_params.name: screenwidth
key_params.note: Camera image width in pixels for focal-distance to FOV conversion

key_params.name: autoexportroot
key_params.note: Root path for automatic channel-name exports

key_params.name: exporttable
key_params.note: DAT table used by DAT table export methods

key_concepts: MoSys CHOP is available only in TouchDesigner Pro.
It receives data from a MoSys camera-tracking system.
The output channels are intended to control a virtual camera.
MoSys TOP can be paired with the CHOP for lens distortion and compositing in virtual production.
Network input is UDP messaging or multicast UDP messaging.
Camera ID filters packets when multiple cameras send data to the same machine.
common_gotchas: When Active is off, data sent to the network port is lost rather than buffered.
On multi-NIC systems, set Local Address so packets arrive on the intended interface.
A blank Camera ID displays the most recent packet each frame regardless of source camera.
Screen Width affects focal-distance to FOV conversion, so it should match the camera image width.
